scope: Event media closure only; this verdict does not represent the full host
decision: The contained Event media now succeeds visually and all business/runtime regressions pass, but the product-box asset does not meet the frozen provenance contract. Its sourceUrl is null and no frozen inventory record was found, so this attempt cannot receive a final PASS.

blockingFindings.requiredFix: Add a verifiable upstream source URL or existing frozen inventory reference for me05-pc-etb-en.png, with its business role and current SHA-256; otherwise replace it with a host asset whose provenance is complete. Do not change the accepted contained composition. Then run a new fresh QA attempt.

contentAndFirstScreenBudget.evidence: Title, live status, date, rules, player/deck metrics, first round, top-deck row and round action are all present and begin inside each fixed viewport. Text remains complete; the title's subpixel scroll/client rounding has no visible clipping.

maskedStructuralRecognition.evidence: Ignoring the two media assets leaves the already-passing Attempt 11 structure intact: warm map-paper mass, bounded split identity card, ruled metric grid, editorial schedule heading and low-radius rectangular content islands. Media adds identity rather than carrying structure alone.

assetLoading.evidence: Both assets are visibly rendered in all three fresh screenshots and the computed event-head backgroundImage resolves both to local /static/images URLs. No failed-image placeholder appears.

assetProvenance.evidence: The logo has upstream URL, SHA-256 and a frozen rendered-asset-inventory reference. The product box has SHA-256 and local path but sourceUrl=null and no matching frozen inventory entry.

interactionParity.evidence: Round and top-deck actions both navigate correctly by pointer, Enter and Space; Back restores the same Event URL, reload is stable and all probes record zero writes.

runtimeAndBusinessSafety.evidence: All fixed viewports report 0px document overflow and zero non-GET requests. Title/status/metrics/schedule/top-deck content remains intact.

otherRoutes.evidence: Plaza, Build, Mine, Round and Detail fresh 390px hashes are byte-identical to Attempt 11 and each has 0px overflow.
